conflicts.detail: Logo 'EST. 2018' and About 'Established 2018' vs 'Since 2021' / 'Since opening in 2021' and '5th Anniversary' (April 2026). The site's own JSON-LD separates them (foundingDate 2018; 'Retail Store Open Since' 2021), so both may be true: company 2018, store 2021. Keep both labels exactly as printed; never write 'since 2018' for the store.

Visible copy: cash, debit cards and CanPay (plus ATM). Joint JSON-LD on every page: paymentAccepted "Cash". Another visible FAQ answer says "we accept cash and debit payment options" (no CanPay). Ask the client which is current.

Visible copy everywhere: 2 ounces / 56 grams (as of April 19, 2026). The home page and /faqs-420 still carry a stale JSON-LD FAQ answer: 'up to 1 ounce of flower ... 28 grams (flower) a day ... 500mg of edibles ... 5g of concentrates'. The rebuild must not regenerate the stale markup.

Three different Facebook URLs: footer link facebook.com/Cape-Cod-Cannabis-112536844674702/; Joint JSON-LD facebook.com/107188521043656/; Rank Math and ezlocal JSON-LD facebook.com/profile.php?id=100077867156438. Ask the client which page is official.

Three pairs: 41.9162662,-69.9883627 (Joint JSON-LD; matches the Google Maps link); 41.916283126902506,-69.98835964200036 (custom Store JSON-LD); 41.916265712481554,-69.98840341462632 (Rank Math Place). All within a few metres; the first is used above.
Printed '1446 US-6'; the footer Google Maps directions link encodes '1446 State Hwy Wellfleet, MA 02667'. Same place, two spellings; print '1446 US-6'.
Joint JSON-LD priceRange '$' vs custom Store JSON-LD '$$'. Neither is visible text. Left unset.
JSON-LD 'Mo,Tu,We,Th,Fr,Sa,Su 8:00 - 8:00' (reads as 8 to 8 with no am/pm) on 489 pages, while every other source says 08:00 to 20:00. Markup error; the rebuild uses hoursSpec above.

Joint JSON-LD alternateName includes 'Medical Marijuana Dispensary', but every visible statement says adult-use / recreational only. Do not carry that alternateName into the rebuild without the client's confirmation.

Visible FAQ: 'required to meet Massachusetts testing and labeling requirements'. Home JSON-LD FAQ (older): 'state-tested and lab-certified to ensure purity, potency, and safety'. The second asserts safety: see docs/COMPLIANCE.md.
'900+' (rounded, static copy) vs '(967)' (live widget count at crawl time). Not a contradiction, but the live count changes; a static rebuild freezes it.

Rank Math JSON-LD Organization name is 'Cape Cod Cannabis in Wellfleet - Best dispensary on Cape Cod.' (a claim used as a name); visible names are 'Cape Cod Cannabis' and 'Cape Cod Cannabis Recreational Dispensary'.
